subject: Reconcile orch-gate multi-claim: land cl90 claims-iteration, keep #25 deny messages, make gate tests green
description:
Triage outcome for branch followup-fix-orch-gate-to-pick-matching-claim-for-cl90. Three branches diverge on the orch-gate deny-message wording: #25 (b0bf426, merged) improved the messages; the multi-claim tests (903df44, merged into test/orch-gate.test.js + test/orch-gate-bash.test.js) assert OLDER text and now FAIL (12/20 and 25/44); cl90 (6ded67b, unmerged) carries a VALUABLE fix (iterate ALL active claims to find the matching worktree path instead of claims[0], fixing false denials when a session has multiple claims) but ALSO a STALE deny-message change that reverts #25. 

GOAL: a single clean reconciliation on main: (1) take cl90's claims-iteration logic ONLY (hooks/orch-gate.sh + hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh — iterate all claims, match the write target's worktree against each claim's branch, not just claims[0]); (2) PRESERVE the current (#25) deny-message wording and the a77e380 fix (resolve branch from the EDIT-TARGET's dir, not ambient cwd) and the 3840ce5 git-VCS exemption — do NOT regress any of those; (3) update the multi-claim test assertions in test/orch-gate.test.js + test/orch-gate-bash.test.js to match the CURRENT deny messages; (4) make BOTH gate test files fully GREEN (run `node test/orch-gate.test.js` and `node test/orch-gate-bash.test.js` — no `timeout` cmd on macOS). Do NOT cherry-pick cl90 wholesale (its message change is backwards). The gate is load-bearing — edits happen in the worktree only (live gate reads from ~/.claude/orchestrator/hooks = main, unaffected until merged).

summary:
Reconciled #32. KEY FINDING: cl90's claims-iteration fix (iterate ALL active claims to match the write target against each claim's registered worktree, replacing claims[0]-only) is ALREADY on main in both hooks/orch-gate.sh and hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh. The `git diff main..cl90` was misleading because cl90 (commit 6ded67b) branched from a pre-#25 base, so it displayed main's improvements as cl90 "deletions". cl90's only unique commit would, if merged, REVERT the #25 deny messages and lose a77e380 (EDIT-TARGET branch resolution) + 3840ce5 (git-VCS exemption) — so I took NOTHING from cl90's source and hand-ported nothing (no port needed; logic present).

PRESERVED on main, unregressed: #25 deny-message wording, a77e380 (branch resolved from edit-target dir, not ambient cwd), 3840ce5 (git-VCS exemption block). Hook files are byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff --stat: only test/orch-gate.test.js touched, 1 line).

TEST RECONCILIATION: Real baseline was much healthier than the stale task snapshot (which said 12/20 and 25/44 fail). Actual before: orch-gate.test.js 19/20 (multi-claim tests already pass), orch-gate-bash.test.js 44/44. Single stale assertion: oversized-patch case asserted deny msg contains 'dispatch a subagent', but current #25 text is 'spawn a background subagent (Agent tool, run_in_background:true)' (the empty-TRIVIAL_DENY_REASON default branch of main_session_deny_message). Updated expected substring to 'spawn a background subagent' — same strength, matches current source. No check weakened.

FINAL: orch-gate.test.js 20/20 (was 19/20), orch-gate-bash.test.js 44/44 (unchanged). Both 0 failed. Committed f2ede5f on orch/attempt/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-32. Daemon NOT restarted (hooks read per-invocation). NOTE: had to force-claim — task was stuck in judging phase (judging=true, judging_since=null) ~5min with no eager judge dispatching to clear its wirings; 2 force-claims remain.
